recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑之間的造血組織大片被細胞質豐富、淡粉紅灰色且呈細纖維狀的大型細胞取代，這些細胞核小而分散、核質比低，形成片狀浸潤，符合儲積症巨噬細胞（storage cell）。
features: Low-power trephine with bony trabeculae and extensive replacement of marrow spaces
Sheets of large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic-grey, finely fibrillary to granular cytoplasm
Small, evenly spaced, round to oval nuclei giving a low N:C ratio
Residual hematopoietic cells and small lymphocytes compressed at the periphery of the infiltrate
Low magnification limits evaluation of the 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasmic texture
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by sheets of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale, finely fibrillary eosinophilic cytoplasm and small bland nuclei, resulting in a low nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Residual hematopoiesis is displaced to the periphery. No atypia, necrosis or granuloma formation is evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by storage cell macrophages, as seen in lysosomal storage disorders such as Gaucher disease; higher-power review, PAS stain and enzyme assay are recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but scattered in a background neoplasm or infection, with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or signet ring cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and are cytokeratin positive, whereas storage cells are CD68/CD163 positive with bland nuclei.
Epithelioid granulomas are compact nodules with elongated nuclei, lymphocytic cuffs and sometimes necrosis rather than diffuse sheets of voluminous pale cells.
Mast cell infiltrates are spindled, paratrabecular and fibrotic with tryptase/CD117/CD25 positivity.
